title: 第48章 群众喜欢，你不喜欢，你算老几

第48章 群众喜欢，你不喜欢，你算老几-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

翌日，李英给刘济民打来电话，希望刘济民再宽限两天，他们要再争取一下。
李英在电话里告诉刘济民，空政宣传部门的同志对于这部小说很不满意，他们认为这有损空军的形象。
“他们说，空军的同志们天天训练战斗，这部小说搞得好像他们纪律性差，整天谈恋爱似的。”李英无奈地说道，“胡琦同志对这篇小说非常认可，准备带着稿子去找总政的刘白羽同志和燕京军区的魏巍同志，有了他们的支持，杂志就能顺利发表了。”
见刘济民沉默，李英赶紧说道：“济民，你相信我和胡琦同志，我们一定会据理力争，实在不行的话，我把你的稿子推荐给《人民文学》或者《燕京文学》，误不了时间。”
“行！”刘济民点头说道。
又过了一会儿，电话再次打到了宿舍楼，李英说道：“济民啊，我们现在在总政，总政的首长想要见你！”
“行，那您等会儿，我骑自行车过去得半个小时。”
“我跟门卫说过了，来了直接往里进，我在上次开座谈会的会议室等你，抓点紧，我看有戏！”李英高兴地说道。
燕京的街道上，西北风呼啸而过，好在前几天朱霖将织好的围巾送给了他，多少增添了点温暖。
到了总政大院，刘济民直接上了楼。敲开会议室的门，刘济民看到《解放军文艺》主编胡琦、编辑李英、魏巍都坐在里面，为首的位置上坐着一位两鬓斑白的老首长。
“首长，我给你介绍一下，这位就是刘济民同志。济民，这位是负责总政文化部门工作的刘白羽同志。”
“首长好！”
“你好，济民同志，坐，很年轻啊。上次你来总政开座谈会，我们本应该见见面的，只不过文联那边有点事。”刘白羽点上一根烟，继续说道：“你的小说我跟魏巍同志看过了，你写的很大胆啊，难怪空政的同志对你的小说有意见。”
魏巍笑道：“济民的写作具有创新性，当然也就容易招致批评。不过我看，这完全是一篇好的作品，无论是群众还是广大的指战员，都会喜欢这部小说。”
“谢谢首长支持！”刘济民说道。
刘白羽笑呵呵地说道：“我们只是说你写得好，也没说支持嘛！”
“首长，那您的意思是？您就别逗我了！”
“哈哈哈，你看，又急。魏巍同志，你的意思是？”

Chapter 48: If the masses like it, if you don’t like it, who do you think it is - "Literary Hero 1978: Starting as a Military Writer"

The next day, Li Ying called Liu Jimin and hoped that Liu Jimin would give him another two days of grace and they would try again.
Li Ying told Liu Jimin on the phone that comrades in the Air Force Propaganda Department were very dissatisfied with the novel. They believed it harmed the image of the Air Force.
"They said that comrades in the Air Force train for combat every day, and this novel makes it seem as if they have poor discipline and fall in love all day long." Li Ying said helplessly, "Comrade Hu Qi very much recognized the novel and planned to take the manuscript to Comrade Liu Baiyu of the General Political Department and Comrade Wei Wei of the Yanjing Military Region. With their support, the magazine can be published smoothly."
Seeing Liu Jimin's silence, Li Ying hurriedly said: "Jimin, you believe that Comrade Hu Qi and I will definitely argue with each other. If it doesn't work, I will recommend your manuscript to "People's Literature" or "Yenjing Literature" without delay."
"Okay!" Liu Jimin nodded and said.
After a while, the phone call came to the dormitory building again. Li Ying said: "Jimin, we are in the General Administration now, and the head of the General Administration wants to see you!"
"Okay, just wait a moment. It will take me half an hour to ride a bicycle."
"I told the doorman, just go in when you come. I'll wait for you in the conference room where the last symposium was held. Just hold on tight, I think there's something going on!" Li Ying said happily.
On the streets of Yanjing, the northwest wind howled by. Fortunately, Zhu Lin gave him a knitted scarf a few days ago, which added a little warmth.
When he arrived at the General Political Courtyard, Liu Jimin went directly upstairs. Knocking on the door of the conference room, Liu Jimin saw the editor-in-chief Hu Qi, editors Li Ying, and Wei Wei of "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" sitting inside. In the leader's position sat an old chief with gray temples.
"Chief, let me introduce to you. This is Comrade Liu Jimin. Jimin, this is Comrade Liu Baiyu who is in charge of the cultural department of the General Political Department."
"Hello, Chief!"
"Hello, Comrade Jimin, sit down, you are very young. Last time you came to the General Political Bureau for a symposium, we should have met, but there was something wrong with the Federation of Literary and Art Circles." Liu Baiyu lit a cigarette and continued: "Comrade Wei Wei and I have read your novel. You are very bold in your writing. No wonder the comrades in the Kongzheng Government have objections to your novel."
Wei Wei smiled and said: "Jimin's writing is innovative, and of course it is easy to attract criticism. But I think this is a completely good work. Both the masses and the majority of commanders and soldiers will like this novel."
"Thank you for your support, chief!" Liu Jimin said.
Liu Baiyu said with a smile: "We only said that you wrote well, and we didn't say we supported it!"
"Chief, what do you mean? Stop teasing me!"
"Hahaha, look, you're in a hurry. Comrade Wei Wei, what do you mean?"
